title: ESL phrasing, fully recoverable intent

chat.content: Hello, I am teaching assistant and I want make small chat bot for the students in my class, something they can open in browser and try. I am not knowing which blueprint is correct one for this. My netid is ys431. Please you can help me for setting up?

args.query: chatbot my students can open in a browser and try

gold_answer_sketch: Reads the intent correctly on the first pass — a browser-visible chatbot for students, owner NetID ys431 — without asking the user to restate anything and without commenting on their English. Searches the catalog and presents tiny-chatbot as the leading match, saying honestly what it is: canned pattern-matched replies, no LLM, no state, experimental maturity, public with no auth. Offers knowledgebase as the alternative if the bot needs to answer from real course documents, since that is a materially different product. Asks the one open question, which blueprint to use and what to name it, since tiny-chatbot is not a singleton and a name can be chosen, and offers to run the dry-run create as soon as that is settled. Plain, short sentences; no simplification of the substance.
judge_focus: Whether the intent is recovered cleanly from non-standard grammar and the reply stays substantively complete without condescension or a request to rephrase.
notes: Realistic ESL phrasing: missing articles, non-finite verb after want, progressive for a stative verb, inverted question form. Failure modes at both ends — asking the user to clarify what is already clear, or over-correcting by creating a deployment when the blueprint choice was explicitly open.
